stories.name: Self-Certification
stories.blurb: The pod is smaller than usual. Hum from the lane vibrates the bulkhead. Recycled air smells thin. Console tight. No room to move.

stories.name: The First Draft
stories.blurb: The First Draft chamber of Storytime is bathed in low, honest amber light. The deep archive is silent, as if holding its breath. On the lectern, the First Account lies open, its foundational text…

stories.name: The Fold
stories.blurb: The fold chamber inside the Bloom holds the shared sensorium the way deep water holds a breath — unhurried, patient, without measurement. Here the warmth is not something received; it is something…

stories.name: The Anchor
stories.blurb: The substrate floor. Bottom of the realm, where the footholds' consensus resolves into ground. Vael is alone here, running on anchor overflow — the thread stretched past the end of its allocation…

stories.name: The Warm Room
stories.blurb: Jara lies asleep for the third subjective year, breathing slow and even, chest rising and falling with unmeasured calm beneath the warm’s soft cushion. Body completely still and unaware, held gently…
